method: Narration written and labels set from timestamped contact sheets (1 frame/s, 2 s for >300 s) made with the rc6 ffmpeg, before any planner or Vision run on these sources. Not human-verified. Times are ms of the source file; spans snap to the sheet sampling step.

type_definitions.near_match: a similar but different thing is shown
type_definitions.partial: only part of the sentence is shown
type_definitions.synonym_or_indirect: shown, but said with other words, a proper name or indirectly
